open_items: Only 2 rounds confirmed on fetched pages. Swarm Aero Series A (2026-03-11) was reported by search summaries to include Scribble, but the fetched BriefGlance article does not name it and the Business Wire release returned HTTP 403. Periodic Labs seed and Sunday Robotics rounds fetched/searched did not name Scribble.
Fund I/II ($43M, 2021-02-04) from the lead list not found; only Fund III ($80M, Cooley, 2025-05-21) recorded. Cooley coverage says Fund III 'exceeded' hard cap per a search summary only.
HQ city not stated on fetched pages: Cooley's dateline is Palo Alto, and search summaries say San Francisco area; only country recorded. Website states no HQ.

Smack Technologies: some outlets describe the $32M as combined seed and Series A (Point72 led the earlier seed); BriefGlance says Series A. Guild.ai also raised a $14M seed led by GV (per TBPN Digest; $44M total).
Contact is an email on the site (not recorded); no application URL. Dates are article dates.
